acceptance_criteria.statement: A Change Saga server deployed in the host's own cloud serves the Saga UI.
The server can serve a Saga maintained outside the target repository.
Readers can follow the Saga's remote references to the corresponding material in the configured target repository.

content.overview: The host is responsible for authentication and access controls. Editor attribution is a possible requirement, not yet a confirmed acceptance criterion. Deployment packaging, repository authentication, and reference revision behavior remain open.
content.statement: As a developer, I can host a Change Saga server in our own cloud and maintain its Saga outside the target repository while retaining remote references to that repository.
content.title: Host the Saga in our own cloud
